title: Paraphrast
summary: PAR'APHRAST, noun [Gr.] One that paraphrases; one that explains or translates in words more ample and clear than the words of the author.

inlines.v: PAR'APHRAST, noun [Gr.] One that paraphrases; one that explains or translates in words more ample and clear than the words of the author.
